hardware_gap: the manifest hardware block records machine/processor/system/release/cpu but NOT core count, thread count, or whether the solve was single-threaded. Core count below is measured on the machine running this benchmark and is NOT evidence about the machine that produced ms_solver=9.14.
constraint_note: item 2 required MEASURING parallel solve time, which runs the AC solver and so conflicts with the 'zero new solves' header. Treated as a hardware benchmark: 930 contingency solves per configuration, no dataset row, no result artifact regenerated.
benchmark_basis: mean over 930 solves per configuration with the JIT warm-up scenario discarded; the committed ms_solver=9.14 is a MINIMUM over 400 solves, a different basis, so the P=1 figure here is not directly comparable
